_comment: Phase 5 autonomy: which tickets Autopilot picks up unattended, and how far it goes without a human.
_jql: Candidates to auto-resolve. Gate on an explicit 'autopilot' label so nothing runs by surprise.
jql: project = PROJ AND labels = autopilot AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC
_maxPerRun: Hard cap on tickets resolved per scan — keeps cost/blast-radius bounded.
_mode: dry-run = intake→plan only (report). build-verify-notify (default) = run through REVIEW, leave a verified branch + notify + post a step-detail Jira comment (audit trail), do NOT open a PR. auto-draft-pr = same comment plus open a DRAFT PR (human still merges). Never merges.
_skipIfBranchExists: Don't re-process a ticket that already has an autopilot/<KEY> branch.
_notify: Push a notification per ticket outcome (ready / blocked / failed).
_owner: Human accountable for Autopilot output. EVERY autonomous-run Jira comment MUST @-mention this person (ADF mention node with this accountId) so they're tagged/notified.
